title: How Similar Are Grokipedia and Wikipedia? A Multi-Dimensional Textual and Structural Comparison
findings: Articles related to religion showed one of the largest differences in similarity between Grokipedia and Wikipedia. In parallel, these articles also exhibited one of the strongest rightward shifts in the political bias of cited sources, indicating that ideological divergence between the two platforms is particularly pronounced in this domain.
